annotations.title: Begin the first turn of a war.app speed game

description: Press Begin in a war.app (Warzone) game whose first turn is a speed race (move order "No-luck cycle": whoever commits their first orders fastest moves first). war.app hides the board until Begin is pressed, and pressing it STARTS YOUR TURN TIMER — call this only when ready to plan and submit at once (warapp_plan_turn, then warapp_submit_turn; in manual distribution, the picks). Refuses games past their first turn, games without the speed first turn, games you are not playing, and games whose board is already visible; reads the board back to report `begun`. The BeginFirstTurn encoding is read from the war.app client, not yet verified live. Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

game_id.description: The war.app game id — the number after GameID= in the game URL (war.app/MultiPlayer?GameID=<n>).
